Description: Scope: Login, registration, JWT, role-based authorization (platform_admin, admin, worker). Outcomes: secure access and correct role routing.
Scope: Layout shell, protected routes, role-based menus, theming.
Scope: Field CRUD, archive, history lifecycle with active flag, history timeline.
Scope: Task CRUD, status transitions, priorities, multi-worker assignment, completion flow.
Scope: Invite/join via code, list, deactivate/reactivate, farm scoping.
Scope: In-app notifications, read/unread, event triggers for assignments and status updates.
Scope: KPIs, charts, recent activity. Admin-focused; platform analytics later.
Scope: Weather by farm location with forecast and fallbacks.
Scope: Platform-wide farm/user visibility and management for platform_admin.
Scope: CI/CD, lint/test/build gates, security headers, rate limiting, logging.
Scope: Unit/integration/e2e baselines; coverage and pipelines.
Scope: Runbooks, API docs, ERD, ADRs, user guides, contribution guidelines.

As a user, I want to log in so that I can access my workspace.\nAcceptance: valid creds issue JWT; role redirect (platform_admin -> /admin/dashboard, others -> /dashboard); token persisted; unauthorized shows error; protected routes redirect to /login.
Build (auth)/login with RHF+zod, wire useAuth.login, handle success/error toasts, route on success.
Implement controller/service: validate email+password, bcrypt compare, sign JWT, return role and farm info.
Seed one platform_admin user for dev; ensure indexes on users(email,role).
Supertest API tests; FE component test of form validation and redirect.
Document login API, response shape, error codes, and FE usage.

Build (auth)/register with farmName, admin user data, RHF+zod; handle success redirect.

API happy/edge paths; FE validation tests.
Document request/response, joinCode, and redirects.
As a worker, I want to join a farm with a code so that I can be assigned tasks.\nAcceptance: code validation, worker linked to farm, limited permissions.

Validate joinCode, link user to farm; return farm info.

Explain join code lifecycle and limitations.
